requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-049 states that the SQLite query-store must operate strictly as a read-only rebuildable projection over the authoritative filesystem artifacts and event ledgers, providing sync, doctor drift detection, and full rebuild capabilities.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-049 states that the SQLite query-store must operate strictly as a read-only rebuildable projection over the authoritative filesystem artifacts and event ledgers, providing sync, doctor drift detection, and full rebuild capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Defines core operational behaviors and functional capabilities of the SQLite query-store component.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-050 states that the toolkit package shall provide high-throughput UTXO coin control, dust analysis, batch payment splitting, consolidation planning, invoice tracking, and local state snapshots capable of indexing up to 50,000 UTXOs in memory.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-050 states that the toolkit package shall provide high-throughput UTXO coin control, dust analysis, batch payment splitting, consolidation planning, invoice tracking, and local state snapshots capable of indexing up to 50,000 UTXOs in memory.
requirements.rationale: Specifies functional capabilities and capacity constraints related to UTXO management.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-051 states that because WalletToolkit uses deterministic synthetic keys derived from the wallet name, it must block wallet creation, address derivation, and spending on any network other than simnet using WALLET_SYNTHETIC_NETWORK_BLOCKED.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-051 states that because WalletToolkit uses deterministic synthetic keys derived from the wallet name, it must block wallet creation, address derivation, and spending on any network other than simnet using WALLET_SYNTHETIC_NETWORK_BLOCKED.
requirements.rationale: Defines strict functional control and security enforcement rules for network access.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-052 states that the jobs package shall execute asynchronous background tasks with durable checkpoint persistence, progress reporting, and configurable retry backoff policies.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-052 states that the jobs package shall execute asynchronous background tasks with durable checkpoint persistence, progress reporting, and configurable retry backoff policies.
requirements.rationale: Specifies functional behavior for executing background tasks and managing state persistence.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-053 states that the L2 client and CLI extension must block all connections and writes to Igra mainnet (chain ID 38833 or any mainnet-marked profile) with MAINNET_CONNECTION_DISABLED and L2_MAINNET_WRITE_BLOCKED regardless of caller flags.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-053 states that the L2 client and CLI extension must block all connections and writes to Igra mainnet (chain ID 38833 or any mainnet-marked profile) with MAINNET_CONNECTION_DISABLED and L2_MAINNET_WRITE_BLOCKED regardless of caller flags.
requirements.rationale: Mandates specific functional access restrictions and error response conditions.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-054 states that walletToolkit.signAndBroadcast must call assertBroadcastNodeSynced to verify that the target node reports isSynced: true before planning, signing, or broadcasting a transaction (currently omitted in verifySpendNetwork).
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-054 states that walletToolkit.signAndBroadcast must call assertBroadcastNodeSynced to verify that the target node reports isSynced: true before planning, signing, or broadcasting a transaction (currently omitted in verifySpendNetwork).
requirements.rationale: Defines a mandatory functional workflow step and precondition check prior to transaction broadcast.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-055 states that walletToolkit should replace its legacy name-derived synthetic identity with real encrypted BIP-39/BIP-32 HD keystores from @hardkas/accounts and remove the deprecated throwing planSend and dummy sendSimulated stubs.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-055 states that walletToolkit should replace its legacy name-derived synthetic identity with real encrypted BIP-39/BIP-32 HD keystores from @hardkas/accounts and remove the deprecated throwing planSend and dummy sendSimulated stubs.
requirements.rationale: Specifies a functional architecture replacement for key management and identity handling.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-056 states that projectionStoreJson.setAll in @hardkas/query-store must use writeFileAtomicSync with fsyncSync, Windows EPERM rename retries, and LOCK_ORDER.index lock acquisition instead of writing directly to a fixed .tmp filename.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-056 states that projectionStoreJson.setAll in @hardkas/query-store must use writeFileAtomicSync with fsyncSync, Windows EPERM rename retries, and LOCK_ORDER.index lock acquisition instead of writing directly to a fixed .tmp filename.
requirements.rationale: Defines specific implementation behavior for atomic file writing and locking mechanisms.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-059 states that installing the unpublished L2 extension from a remote package registry must be refused with EXTENSION_NOT_PUBLISHED before any package manager runs, allowing installation only from a local tarball verified by an explicit --sha256 digest.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-059 states that installing the unpublished L2 extension from a remote package registry must be refused with EXTENSION_NOT_PUBLISHED before any package manager runs, allowing installation only from a local tarball verified by an explicit --sha256 digest.
requirements.rationale: Specifies functional validation and security gating for package installation routes.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-057 states that the @hardkas/plugin-rpc-backend package should implement connection pooling, automatic reconnect on WebSocket drop, and randomized retry jitter before being promoted from private workspace status to a published package.
requirements.refined_statement: The @hardkas/plugin-rpc-backend package shall implement connection pooling with a maximum pool size of 50, automatic WebSocket reconnection within ≤ 2 seconds of drop, and randomized retry jitter with a range of 100-500 ms prior to package publication.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-058 states that the internal storage and adapter packages (@hardkas/storage-postgres, @hardkas/storage-sqlite, @hardkas/plugin-local-indexer, @hardkas/simulator-adapters) currently have 0 dedicated unit test files and should be covered by automated tests before publication.
requirements.refined_statement: The internal storage and adapter packages (@hardkas/storage-postgres, @hardkas/storage-sqlite, @hardkas/plugin-local-indexer, @hardkas/simulator-adapters) shall achieve a minimum of 80% code line coverage with automated unit tests prior to package publication.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-060 states that the internal testnet qualification runner shall enforce fail-closed UTXO reservations, ambiguity-guarded transaction submissions, secret-redacted receipts, and zero automated public faucet or funding requests.
requirements.refined_statement: The internal testnet qualification runner shall enforce fail-closed UTXO reservation handling upon resource contention, reject ambiguous transaction submissions with a non-zero error code, redact all known private keys and secrets from generated logs and receipts, and maintain a hard limit of zero automated public faucet or funding requests.
